column15: Rex is a playful 2-year-old Border Collie with boundless energy and a love for fetch. He is house-trained and great with older children.
column16: Daily exercise of at least 60 minutes. Brush coat twice a week. Thrives with mental stimulation.

column15: Luna is a gentle 1-year-old Siamese cat who loves warm laps and sunny windowsills. She is quiet and adapts quickly to new homes.
column16: Indoor only. Brush weekly. Interactive play daily to prevent boredom.

column15: Tweety is a cheerful budgerigar who mimics sounds and enjoys human interaction. Comes hand-tamed from our aviary.
column16: Fresh water daily. Social species — consider keeping a pair. Cage minimum 60 cm wide.

column15: Nemo is a captive-bred clownfish ideal for a marine aquarium. Hardy and adaptable.
column16: Saltwater tank 100 l minimum. Temperature 24-26 C. Feed twice daily with marine flake.

column15: Fluffy is a Holland Lop rabbit with floppy ears and a calm temperament. Litter-trained and used to being handled.
column16: Daily hay as 80 % of diet. Fresh vegetables. Clean enclosure weekly. Needs daily free-roaming time.

column15: Max is a purebred German Shepherd with Schutzhund I title. Excellent temperament and fully trained for family protection.
column16: 2 hours exercise daily. Professional grooming every 6 weeks. Not suitable for first-time dog owners.

column15: Pepper is a hand-reared cockatiel with a friendly confident character. She whistles tunes and enjoys head scratches.
column16: Out-of-cage time at least 2 hours daily. Varied diet of seeds pellets and fresh fruit.

column15: Goldie is a fancy goldfish with a flowing twin tail. Perfect centrepiece for a cold-water aquarium.
column16: Cold-water tank 80 l minimum per fish. Weekly 20 % water change. Feed once daily.

column15: Bella is a British Shorthair with a plush blue-grey coat and an unflappable temperament. She suits apartment life perfectly and rarely demands attention.
column16: Brush once a week. Monitor food intake — breed is prone to obesity. Annual vet check.

column15: Rocky is a two-year-old Labrador Retriever with an outgoing personality and an unshakeable love of water. He gets on with everyone.
column16: 90 minutes exercise daily. Weekly brushing. Keep away from standing water unsupervised.

column15: Cleo is a captive-bred bearded dragon who is fully tame and enjoys sitting on shoulders. A calm and rewarding reptile for beginners.
column16: UV-B lighting essential. Basking spot 40 C. Insects and leafy greens daily.

column15: Whiskers is a long-haired guinea pig who chatters and purrs when handled. Social by nature — happiest in pairs.
column16: Daily hay and Vitamin C-rich vegetables. Fresh water always available. Clean cage twice weekly.

column15: Shadow is a three-year-old rescued Dobermann who has completed basic obedience training. Affectionate and loyal with known people.
column16: Minimum 2 hours exercise daily. Not recommended with small children or other dogs.

column15: Kiwi is an Orange-winged Amazon parrot with a large vocabulary and a strong personality. Bonds deeply with one person and never stops talking.
column16: Out-of-cage minimum 3 hours daily. Varied fresh diet essential. Loud — not suited to apartments.

column15: Mochi is a rescued tabby approximately 7 years old. Calm and undemanding — a perfect companion for a quieter household.
column16: Indoor only. Twice-daily feeding. Annual dental check required. Settled and litter-trained.

column15: Spot is a common comet goldfish suited to a garden pond or large cold-water aquarium. Hardy and long-lived.
column16: Pond minimum 1000 l or aquarium 80 l per fish. Weekly partial water change. No tropical fish mix.

column15: Duke is a two-year-old purebred Rottweiler from champion lines with Schutzhund BH title. Outstanding character and drive.
column16: Experienced owners only. Structured daily exercise. Professional grooming every 8 weeks.

column15: Hammy is a Syrian hamster — nocturnal and self-sufficient. Ideal first pet for older children who understand he sleeps during the day.
column16: Nocturnal. Wheel essential. Spot-clean daily full clean weekly. No other hamsters in the same cage.
